analytic_model.outer_fillet_interpretation: Constant-radius cylindrical rolling fillet between the two linear tapered side planes; quarter-arc neighborhoods and source-selected sections only. Bound calculations use extended planes/cylinders and can underestimate finite-surface distance.
exclusions: Global final BRep minima at every join, hole or edge
Every final BRep wall and transition; native deletion/health separately confirmed below
Sensor cartridge and USB geometry covered by separate evidence

straight_side_witness.why_definite: At Y6.5 the outer face is beyond the corner tangency and is a straight taper plane. Z53 lies inside the R5.3 relief and before the housing rear. The housing M3 boss ends atZ51.6, so it does not reinforce this section.

original_cover_pad_relief_issue.rounded_rear_diagonal_note: Approximately0.35mm thin rim. The straight-side witness independently proves a below2mm section without relying on the fillet approximation.

proposed_external_head_correction.housing: All4 rear-cover bearing-pad clearance extrudes deleted; ordinary R3.6 rear cavity retained.
proposed_external_head_correction.cover: All4 local bearing-pad joins and4 head recesses deleted; original2.2 mm cover and3.4 mm through holes retained.
proposed_external_head_correction.hardware: Four nominal M3x8 screws positioned with under-head seating CaseDepth=56 using native joint origins and updated occurrence expressions.
proposed_external_head_correction.important_dependency: Both bearing pads and recesses were removed. Removing only pads while retaining1.65 mm head recesses would leave0.55 mm cover stock.
proposed_external_head_correction.physical_limit: Axial overlap is geometric only; actual insert engagement, fastener torque and closed-cover bearing/preload remain physical qualification items.

conclusion: Native reports confirm removal of the identified R5.3 relief thin section and retention of the full2.2 mm cover with external M3 heads. The selected analytic sections/annuli meet nominal2 mm. No whole-model minimum-thickness, print-strength, torque or retention certification is claimed.

native_correction_confirmation.evidence_scope: Native reports confirm feature deletion, resulting cover bounds, screw positions, healthy recompute and zero positive-volume overlaps. They do not measure every final wall thickness.
